# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_004_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 4

**1** Jesus said: "An old man will have no shame in asking a week-old infant where life is found — and that old man will find life.

**2** For many who are first will end up last,

**3** and they will become one."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Will have no shame" — renders the hesitation/reluctance element; the reversal requires humility
- "Week-old infant" — makes "seven days" vivid and concrete
- "Where life is found" — "place of life" rendered as a question-form
- "End up last" — colloquial but captures the reversal's finality
- "Become one" — the unification goal rendered simply; "single one" is a technical term but "one" suffices
